observations: Photo 0 shows an orange digital camera with 'Canon' branding and 'DIGITAL 10MP' text on the front lens ring. The lens is labeled '10.0 MP', '24.0mm', and 'F2.8'. A black wrist strap is attached.

Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with a screen displaying 'Memory card error'. The camera has a silver body with a control dial and buttons. The screen is off, and the camera appears to be held in hand.
Photo 2 shows the side and front of the camera from a different angle. The lens is visible, and the camera body has visible wear and scratches. The wrist strap is still attached.
All photos have a blue background and watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'AURAIART'.

claims.claim: Digital camera, used and in good condition
claims.evidence: Photos show visible wear and scratches on the camera body, especially in photo 2. The screen in photo 1 shows a 'Memory card error', which may indicate a hardware or software issue, contradicting 'good condition'.
No flash is visible in any photo. The camera body does not show a flash unit. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.
Photo 0 shows '10.0 MP' on the lens ring.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
